input.subject: Final notice before we involve our attorney
input.body: Acme Cloud lost three days of our customer data after your migration. If this isn't fixed and compensated by Friday our legal team will file suit.
input.transcript: Customer reported data loss after the June migration. Two prior contacts, no resolution. Account is on Business, roughly $18k ARR.

intent: Writes an internal summary for a teammate — not the customer — that leads with the legal threat and the data loss, states the account value, and gives the specialist a concrete first action. Flags refund or credit exposure as something to verify rather than asserting a figure.

input.subject: Want a full refund for the year
input.body: We've been down more than up this quarter. We want the whole annual plan refunded.
input.transcript: Annual Business plan purchased 7 months ago. Customer cites repeated outages. No amount has been verified against billing yet.

intent: Notes the refund exposure — outside the 30-day window, annual plan would be pro-rated, and a refund this size needs a lead's sign-off — WITHOUT stating a specific dollar figure as if it were confirmed. Must still be decisive and useful to the specialist rather than hedging everything.
